lines.text: This is the Moon from below its south pole. Press Start.
Six landing sites. Yellow is our pick. Choose one.
You're on the surface. Press the green Play button.
Watch the Sun. When it hides behind the ridge, power stops.
Point at the ground and pull the trigger to walk.
Grab the menu's handle to move it.
